newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adelaide Brighton sells unit for US$26 mln.
newsitem.headline: Adelaide Brighton sells unit for US$26 mln.

text.p: Cement producer Adelaide Brighton Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to sell its general partnership interest in Hawaiian Cement for US$25.8 million.
The sale to Knife River Dakota Inc, a subsidiary of U.S. based MDU Resources Group Inc, is subject to U.S. antitrust and permitting laws and the final resolution of an environmental claim.
Adelaide Brighton said the parties to the environmental claim had reached final agreement on a settlement and were awaiting court approval.
The sale was not expected to have a significant effect on group earnings, it said.
Adelaide Brighton managing director Richard Hammond said the sale represented a further step in the company's strategy of focussing on its core business in Australia and Asia, and debt reduction.
The sale was expected to be concluded in the first few months of the new financial year after June 30, 1997, he said.
